standard.summary: 连续不推进余弦相位的最大步数。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The maximum number of consecutive steps the cosine phase may be held back.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 连续不推进余弦相位的最大步数。0 表示自动保护上限（约 5% 有效训练步，最多 200 步），避免训练 loss 形成负反馈循环。

advanced_en.principle: Maximum number of consecutive steps without advancing the cosine phase. 0 = automatic guard cap (about 5% of effective training steps, at most 200), preventing a negative feedback loop in training loss.
